reference_sql:
WITH december_purchases AS (
  -- one row per purchase event of 1 to 31 December 2025 (Dublin days): only the columns the totals need
  SELECT traffic_source.medium AS medium, list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'value')[1].value AS v
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'purchase'
    AND event_date BETWEEN '20251201' AND '20251231'
)
SELECT medium, COUNT(*) AS purchases,
  SUM(COALESCE(v.int_value, v.float_value, v.double_value)) AS revenue
FROM december_purchases
GROUP BY medium

WHERE event_name = 'purchase' AND event_date BETWEEN '20251201' AND '20251231'
